definition: For each of six measured responses separately, in-band complex MSE divided by measured mean squared response may exceed attainable seven-mode standard fit by at most1e-6; all output spectra must reproduce the submitted poles/residues/residual terms.
reference_type: Attainable rational-response fit, not measured mode truth
tolerance_provenance: Declared0.1% additional relative RMS response budget and numerical derived-spectrum tolerance; not modal confidence limits.
